elements.name: A1 - Open an account successfully

steps.name: I am on the ZincBank sign-up page
I open an account with a unique email and password
I should see the account approval message

elements.name: A2 - Sign in with correct credentials

steps.name: I have an existing ZincBank account
I sign in with the correct credentials
I should be taken to the dashboard

elements.name: A2 - Sign in with an incorrect password

steps.name: I have an existing ZincBank account
I sign in with an incorrect password
I should see a sign-in error and remain on the login page

elements.name: A3 - Sign up with an already-registered email is rejected

steps.name: I have an existing ZincBank account
I try to open another account with the same email
I should not reach the approval screen

elements.name: D1 - Transfer between my own accounts

steps.name: I am signed in to ZincBank
I transfer money between my accounts
the transfer should be completed

elements.name: D2 - Pay a company I owe

steps.name: I am signed in to ZincBank
I have a saved payee
I pay a bill to the payee
the bill payment should be completed

elements.name: D3 - Add a payee to my list

steps.name: I am signed in to ZincBank
I add a payee to my list
the payee should appear in my list

elements.name: D4 - Transfer with insufficient funds is blocked

steps.name: I am signed in to ZincBank
I try to transfer more than I have
I should see an insufficient funds error and no transfer happens

elements.name: D5 - Pressing pay twice does not charge twice

steps.name: I am signed in to ZincBank
I submit the transfer twice
only one transfer should be recorded
